questions.subject: PHYSICS_EM
questions.topic: Charge reached after one time constant
questions.learningObjective: Compute charge after one time constant
questions.stem: A marine biologist's tank charges a capacitor; after one time constant the charge reaches what fraction of maximum?
questions.explanation: After one tau charge is (1-1/e) about 63% of max. The 37% is the remaining gap, the trap.
questions.hint: Use 1 minus e to the minus one.
